review_candidates.description: Location/Address: 100% On-site in San Diego, CA Travel & Passport: 20%, CONUS and OCONUS Position Description We are urgently seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer III to design, build, integrate, and sustain secure cloud infrastructure and application runtime environments supporting mission-critical systems. This role will work across cloud compute, storage, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, monitoring, and security to provide reliable and scalable platforms for operational applications. The candidate will collaborate with software, platform, network, cybersecurity, and systems engineering teams to integrate commercial, government, and proprietary software into cohesive cloud-based environments. The role requires strong cloud and Linux fundamentals, hands-on troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to solve complex infrastructure challenges while contributing to the continued evolution of scalable, automated, and secure cloud architectures. Incorporated in 2002, The Marlin Alliance is a digital transformation company dedicated to ensuring our clients compete and win in tomorrow's digital world. We specialize in creating technical solutions that allow for seamless execution of automated business processes and the generation of governed, machine-consumable data. From strategic planning to advanced analytics and cybersecurity, our team provides cutting-edge, cross-disciplinary solutions. We are seeking motivated professionals who share our agile, solution-oriented mindset and are ready to deliver the real, practical results relied upon by our clients. Duties & Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and sustain production cloud infrastructure supporting compute, storage, networking, containerized applications, and mission-critical workloads. Manage cloud compute and storage resources, including EC2 instances and block, file, and object storage, to maintain system availability, data persistence, performance, reliability, and efficient resource utilization. Deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and microservices across Kubernetes environments, including container runtime, workload scheduling, service discovery, networking, ingress, and application availability. Implement and optimize dynamic resource management and scaling strategies across cloud and Kubernetes environments using workload demand, performance requirements, operational needs, and infrastructure cost considerations. Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement application orchestration and runtime environments that integrate decoupled services, commercial products, Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) software, and proprietary applications into cohesive application workflows. Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and health telemetry across cloud infrastructure, compute resources, containers, applications, and storage to support proactive system management and rapid troubleshooting. Configure and maintain cloud networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, NACLs, load balancers, and supporting network services required for secure application connectivity. Partner with cybersecurity and engineering teams to implement operating system hardening, least-privilege access, IAM controls, secure network configurations, data protection requirements, and applicable security and compliance baselines. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, and operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, CI/CD, and other automation technologies where appropriate. Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support across cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, application, network, storage, and security environments while documenting architectures, configurations, procedures, and recommended solutions. Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education And Experience Strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, systems administration, DevOps, or related technical disciplines. Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, administering, troubleshooting, and sustaining cloud-based compute, storage, networking, and application infrastructure. Experience administering Linux-based systems and troubleshooting operating system, application, resource utilization, connectivity, and infrastructure performance issues. Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications using Docker, containerd, Kubernetes, or similar container and orchestration technologies. Understanding of Kubernetes architecture and operations, including workloads, Pods, Services, networking, ingress, resource management, scaling, and application deployment. Experience with cloud networking concepts, including virtual networks, subnets, routing, security groups, access controls, load balancing, and secure connectivity. Experience implementing or supporting monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability capabilities for infrastructure and application environments. Understanding of cloud security, IAM, least-privilege access, system hardening, data protection, network security, and secure configuration practices. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose complex issues spanning cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, containers, applications, storage, networking, and security. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with software, infrastructure, platform, networking, cybersecurity, program, and operational stakeholders. Preferred Skills And Experience Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, EBS, EFS, S3, VPCs, subnets, Security Groups, route tables, NACLs, IAM, Auto Scaling Groups, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, and related infrastructure services. Experience administering AWS EKS or self-managed Kubernetes clusters and supporting containerized microservices in production environments. Experience implementing Kubernetes scaling and resource management using Horizontal Pod Autoscalers, Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, resource requests and limits, quotas, or similar capabilities. Experience with monitoring and observability technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar platforms. Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or similar declarative provisioning tools. Experience integrating cloud and container deployments with CI/CD or GitOps technologies such as GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Flux, or similar platforms. Experience using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages to automate infrastructure provisioning, administration, maintenance, monitoring, and health checks. Experience integrating GOTS, Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS), third-party, legacy, or proprietary software into modern cloud and containerized environments. Familiarity with AMI management, CIS Benchmarks, STIGs, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secrets management, and other security practices applicable to government cloud environments. Experience supporting distributed, hybrid cloud, or other complex application environments. Experience supporting government, defense, classified, or other security- and compliance-driven cloud environments. Education And Certification Requirements Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Experience Current Security+ Certificate Citizenship And Clearance Requirements U.S. Citizenship required No dual citizenship TS/SCI Eligible, security clearance required Work Environment / Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. Typical office environment with no unusual hazards. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Constant sitting while using the computer terminal. Constant use of sight abilities while reviewing documents. Constant use of speech/hearing abilities for communication. Occasional reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching may be required. Occasional lifting, up to 20 pounds. A constant state of mental alertness. Frequent work under deadlines. Job Classification Salary Range: $120,000–$200,000 Disclaimer This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. review_candidates.description: Job Title: Cloud Engineer Location: Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex Salary Range: $100,000-$115,000/year + Bonus Eligibility Benefits: This position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). About The Company: Our client is a growing organization focused on modernizing its technology infrastructure through cloud-first initiatives. As part of an ongoing digital transformation, the company is investing heavily in Microsoft technologies, cloud security, automation, and enterprise infrastructure improvements to support future growth. Job Description: We are looking for an experienced Cloud Engineer to join a collaborative infrastructure team supporting enterprise cloud operations and modernization efforts. This role will play a critical part in the design, administration, automation, and optimization of Microsoft Azure technologies while contributing to cloud migration and security initiatives. The ideal candidate brings strong Azure expertise, a solutions-oriented mindset, and a desire to continuously learn and expand their technical capabilities. This position offers exposure to a wide range of cloud technologies and the opportunity to make an immediate impact in a rapidly evolving environment. Key Responsibilities: Manage and support Azure cloud infrastructure across multiple business systems and services. Administer Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot solutions to streamline endpoint provisioning and device management. Configure and maintain identity security controls, privileged access management, and data protection technologies. Create, update, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts to automate cloud administration tasks and operational processes. Assist with cloud migration projects, platform upgrades, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Monitor system performance, availability, and security while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement. Maintain and support Azure services including storage, identity management, key management, virtual infrastructure, and related cloud resources. Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to implement best practices and resolve technical issues. Provide technical support for cloud-based applications, integrations, and enterprise platforms. Participate in planning and deploying new technologies that enhance scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. Qualifications: Minimum 5 years of experience supporting and engineering Microsoft Azure environments. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot administration. Strong knowledge of Azure security tools, including privileged access management and information protection solutions. Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation skills. Experience supporting Azure Active Directory, cloud storage, virtualization, identity services, and enterprise infrastructure. Understanding of cloud architecture, best practices, and system lifecycle management. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and implement sustainable solutions. Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Azure certification such as AZ-104 or a higher-level Azure certification is highly preferred. Additional Details: Opportunity to join a team actively expanding and improving enterprise cloud capabilities. Position supports the full cloud lifecycle, including administration, engineering, maintenance, enhancements, migrations, and integrations. Strong focus on Microsoft technologies and Azure-based solutions. Ideal for an individual who enjoys balancing operational support with engineering and automation initiatives. Seeking a self-motivated professional who is curious, adaptable, and eager to continue developing their cloud expertise. Perks: Exposure to large-scale Azure deployments and cloud transformation projects. Opportunity to work alongside experienced cloud and security professionals. Professional development and certification growth opportunities. Collaborative culture that encourages learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.

review_candidates.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! As a Security Operations Engineer II, you will engineer, operate, and automate capabilities that support the company’s Cyber Defense program. You will maintain security platforms and perform initial triage of cybersecurity incidents. You will work with incident responders and technology teams to improve detection, containment, and recovery. Success in this role means reliable security services, faster response, and less manual work. Outcomes and Activities Information Security This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member. Operate, maintain, and improve enterprise Cyber Defense platforms across endpoint, web, network, monitoring, and automation services. Maintain next-generation SIEM integrations; onboard telemetry and resolve ingestion, parsing, or data-quality issues. Maintain endpoint detection and response capabilities; support investigations and approved containment actions. Manage secure web access policies, inspection controls, and approved exceptions; troubleshoot access and performance issues. Support web application protections with network and application teams; help implement rules, logging, integrations, and approved exceptions. Perform initial triage of cybersecurity alerts and incidents; gather evidence, document findings, determine scope, and escalate as needed. Support approved containment, remediation, and recovery actions across enterprise and cloud environments. Develop and tune detection logic to improve signal quality and investigative value. Build response playbooks and automate repeatable investigation and response tasks using scripting, APIs, and webhooks. Use Infrastructure as Code, version control, testing, and change-management practices to maintain approved Cyber Defense resources. Use AI-assisted workflows to improve analysis and efficiency while applying access controls, testing, human oversight, and audit requirements. Monitor platform health; maintain technical documentation; share knowledge; and participate in security projects and the on-call rotation. Other Perform all other duties as assigned. Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Remains compliant with our policies, processes and legal guidelines. Works primarily remotely with some occasional travel to a Credit Acceptance building. Competencies: Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience. Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions. One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively. Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum 2 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, incident response, or a related technical field. Experience triaging cybersecurity alerts or incidents and supporting approved containment actions. Hands-on experience supporting enterprise security platforms in at least two areas such as SIEM, EDR, secure web access, WAF, automation, or detection engineering. Experience using a scripting or automation language and working with APIs, webhooks, or structured configuration files. Experience with version control and Infrastructure as Code concepts. Working knowledge of cloud services and cloud security logs. Understanding of secure authentication, credential handling, and least-privilege access. Knowledge of incident response, common attacker techniques, and established cybersecurity frameworks. Ability to troubleshoot across multiple technologies and produce clear technical documentation. Preferred: Experience investigating incidents in public cloud environments and using cloud logs to determine scope. Experience with security orchestration, incident-response automation, telemetry onboarding, or detection engineering. Experience with secure web access or web application protection. Experience creating reusable Infrastructure as Code modules. Experience using AI-assisted development, agent-based workflows, or containerized automation. Relevant cybersecurity, security operations, cloud fundamentals, or automation certifications. Understanding of Credit Acceptance’s business model, operations and business terminology. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and common attack methods. Ability to connect security telemetry with investigative needs and translate response needs into maintainable automation. Sound judgment during incident triage, containment, and escalation. Critical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly. Ability to manage competing priorities and act independently. Clear written and verbal communication tailored to the audience. Ability to work across teams, share knowledge, and escalate risk appropriately Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $84,670 – $124,184. This position is eligible for an annual variable cash bonus, between 7.5 - 15%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego.
